correctness.rationale: Directly derive the exact block equations from the Leibniz identity. For odd blocks, square-zero symplectic-self-adjoint maps correspond to an isotropic image and a nonsingular symmetric map from U* to U, yielding I_{h,r}S_r. For even blocks, the unique (T,w,a) coordinates yield T²=Tw=0 and three precisely calculated rank shifts. Closure inside Lagrangian bundles establishes geometric irreducibility, rationality, and the stated floor(m²/4) dimension. Independently constructed exhaustive finite-field enumerations cover 13 side-block spectra and two full Leibniz spaces; small checks are not substitutes for the all-parameter proof. The result is explicitly for reduced varieties, not scheme-theoretic reducedness.
